title: Unnamed president and wife see a ship while fishing on the coast
place_text: Coast of an unnamed large country (G7 member)

tellings.quote: The president and his wife, the first lady, were on vacation on the coast fishing, and this ship was descending there.

plain: The president of a large country, one of the G7 group of rich nations, was on holiday fishing on the coast with his wife when they watched a ship come down from the sky. Kiran Ilum Xenov, who was once president of a Russian republic and says he was taken by aliens himself, says the president told him this but does not name him. If true, it would mean a sitting world leader saw one of these craft for himself.
